description: Nucleoid collects and selects live lists with Ruby spellings
code:
prices = [2, 4, 6]
rate = 2
limit = 3
scaled = prices.collect(price -> price * rate)
kept = prices.select(price -> price > limit)
assert([scaled, kept], [[4, 8, 12], [4, 6]])
prices.push(8)
rate = 3
limit = 5
assert([scaled, kept], [[6, 12, 18, 24], [6, 8]])
assert(scaled, prices.map(price -> price * rate))
assert(kept, prices.filter(price -> price > limit))
[scaled, kept]

description: Nucleoid collects selected class members with Ruby spellings
code:
class Bid(who, amount):
    this.who = who
    this.amount = amount
limit = 50
names = Bid.select(bid -> bid.amount > limit).collect(bid -> bid.who)
ada = Bid("ada", 40)
bo = Bid("bo", 65)
assert(names, ["bo"])
ada.amount = 70
assert(names, ["ada", "bo"])
limit = 60
assert(names, Bid.filter(bid -> bid.amount > limit).map(bid -> bid.who))
names
